# Patient RX System v2.0.58

## Service Date History And Print/Export Release

- Added branch-safe staging setup and documented the staging-to-develop-to-production workflow.
- Added patient service date history tracking without changing the current 90-day service date behavior.
- Shows service date history with related RX records on patient profile/timeline screens.
- Added print and CSV export options for patient timeline history, service-date related RX records, and RX History previous service date cycles.
- Fixed RX Records detail printing so the detail modal closes before opening the print preview.
- Clarified Patient Timeline wording so full-history printing/exporting is visually separate from related-RX print/CSV actions.

## Validation

- Changed JavaScript files passed `node --check`.
- `git diff --check` passed.
- `npm run staging:check` passed.
- Targeted browser smoke passed for RX detail print preview and Patient Timeline labels.
- Production `server.exe` build completed and version check passed.
